verdict.rationale: Lovable lets users download or Git-sync their full codebase (open, standard code you own) and gives direct SQL editor access to the underlying Supabase database, supporting a 'leave with your code and data' workflow. However, there is no explicit documented one-click 'export all data' feature (e.g., data dump/backup format) beyond manual SQL queries, and no mention of exporting non-code assets like auth records or storage files in an open format. Missing for 10: a dedicated data export/backup feature covering all Cloud data (DB, storage, auth) in an open format, and independent confirmation that this works smoothly in practice.
